message:
The other evening, we found ourselves having a little family meeting about our emergency plans. Instead of diving into the serious stuff, we turned it into a cozy event—snuggling on the couch with popcorn and hot cocoa. As we chatted about our go-bags and what documents we need handy, we laughed about our favorite snacks to include and who would be in charge of the family playlist. It was a reminder that preparedness doesn’t have to feel heavy; it can be a chance to bond and be a little silly together. 

What’s something you’d want to pack that would make any situation feel a bit more like home? 😊
